summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, an upgrade to Sonnet 4.6 with improved agentic reasoning, tool use and coding performance, priced at $2/$10 per million input/output tokens and available across all plans.

practices.reason: A released model shows stated, evaluated gains in agentic tool use, coding and reasoning over its predecessor and is now the default model for two plan tiers.
practices.quote: It’s a substantial improvement over its predecessor, Sonnet 4.6, on important aspects of agentic performance like reasoning, tool use, coding, and knowledge work

notable_reason: Sonnet 5 becomes the default model for Anthropic's Free and Pro plans with disclosed pricing, tokenizer changes, rate-limit adjustments and a detailed safety/capability comparison against Opus 4.8, all directly relevant to teams building on Claude.
